title: LETTER 12: Letter to Bank Manager — Requesting Education Loan

blocks.content: Topic: Write a letter to the Branch Manager of State Bank of India requesting an education loan for pursuing a Master's degree from IIM Ahmedabad.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Follows the modern block format for formal letters with proper sender and receiver address layout.
The subject line must be concise and explicitly state the request for an education loan.
Body paragraph should highlight academic background, secured college admission, and total financial requirement.
Always include an enclosure section at the end detailing supporting documents like fee structure and offer letter.

blocks.content: LETTER 12: Letter to Bank Manager — Requesting Education Loan
Subject: Application for Education Loan for Post-Graduate Programme at IIM Ahmedabad

I am Nikhil Gupta, son of Mr. Rajiv Gupta, a Savings Account holder with your branch for over 15 years (Account No. SBI-XXXX1234). I am writing to request an education loan to fund my Post-Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Ahmedabad, one of India's premier management institutions.

I have been offered admission to IIM Ahmedabad for the academic batch of 2025–27. The total programme fee, including tuition, hostel, and other institutional charges, amounts to Rs. 28,00,000 for two years. Having exhausted my family's savings for the first instalment, I require a loan of Rs. 22,00,000 to meet the remaining programme costs, living expenses, and examination fees. My family is prepared to offer our residential property at 23, Rajendra Nagar, Bhopal, as collateral security for the loan.

I understand that under SBI's Scholar Loan Scheme, premier institution students receive preferential interest rates and do not require guarantors. I request you to kindly consider my application under this scheme. I am prepared to provide all necessary documents — my admission letter from IIM-A, fee structure, my father's income proof, property documents, and our KYC documents — at your earliest convenience.
The placement record of IIM Ahmedabad, with a median salary of Rs. 29 LPA, assures a strong repayment capacity post-graduation. I am deeply committed to fulfilling my loan obligations promptly.
I earnestly request you to process my application on priority and grant me this vital financial support.

items: A clear and direct subject line is critical for evaluating formal letter writing skills in competitive exams.
Ensure proper salutation (Respected Sir/Madam) and formal complimentary close (Yours faithfully).
Explicitly mentioning attachments/enclosures adds authenticity and earns higher marks in descriptive tests.

blocks.content: Examiner's Tip: Mentioning the 'SBI Scholar Loan Scheme' shows product knowledge. Including placement statistics for repayment assurance is a smart technique. Always quantify: state the exact loan amount, fee structure, and collateral offered.
